result.summary: Do not dispatch unchanged: a mandatory verification gate rejects the prescribed implementation.

findings.title: Deletion-count gate includes the diff header
findings.body: The prescribed destructure replacement produces one deleted source line plus the `--- a/src/cli/dream.js` header. `grep -cE '^-'` counts both, returning 2 where the gate requires 1. Under `set -e`, every compliant implementation therefore fails verification before reaching the required test runs.
findings.recommendation: Require the existing `DREAM_DEL` numstat value to equal 1, or explicitly exclude diff headers. Verify the corrected gate against the prescribed three edits.

next_steps: Correct the deletion-count gate before dispatching the work package.
